verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Claude Code plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs that provides interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing, which matches the story directly. The GitHub README separately confirms IDE usage. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the diff and selection-sharing workflow behaves, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the JetBrains plugin.
